01_Introduction.MOV.full_text: Hello my name is Chan Jin Lee and this is my final project called Sandino Sleep. Sandino Sleep is a smart battery system built using an ESP32 with three simulations and a blind IoT platform. It monitors temperature, humidity, room brightness, occupancy and gas safety. It can control the main light, fan, night light, puzzle and curtain server.

segments.text: Hello my name is Chan Jin Lee and this is my final project called Sandino Sleep.
Sandino Sleep is a smart battery system built using an ESP32
with three simulations and a blind IoT platform. It monitors temperature, humidity, room brightness,
occupancy and gas safety. It can control the main light,
fan, night light, puzzle and curtain server.

02_Hardware_and_Architecture.MOV.full_text: This is the work we circuit, the DHT-22 measures temperature and humidity, the PIR sensor detects occupancy, the photo resistor measures illuminance and the MQ-2 provide gas safety input. The systems also contains relays for the mainline and fan, RGB status indicators, a light light indicator, a bussel and a curtain symbol. The ESP-32 processes the sensor readings locally, it then sends telemetry to bling through virtual data streams. The bling dashboard displays both sensor readings and confirm actuator states.

13_Network_and_Security.MOV.full_text: The ESP32 continues running its sensor and save the logic locally even if the cloud connection is interacted. When the connection is restored the device reconnects and the brain telemetry updates again. For security the brain token is stored in a private in North Secrets life. It is not displayed in the video or committed as a public credential.

14_Reflection.MOV.full_text: This project demonstrates the importance of separating requested control states from confirmed actual state. It also shows why gas safety must take priority over comfort controls. The system is validated to show simulations and cloud interactions, however the work rate for the type does not replace the defied gas alarms. Main safety testing on real sensor calibration.
